## Acknowledgment

This website is **adapted** from the Quarto template developed by **[Prof. Daniel J. McDonald](https://dajmcdon.github.io/)**. If you are interested in how it works, you can check out [this page](https://dajmcdon.github.io/other/) on his website for an introduction.
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.width=12, fig.height=2.5}
library(ggplot2)

x <- seq(0, 10, length.out = 400)

df <- data.frame(
  x = x,
  y1 = sin(x) * 0.3 + 0.5,
  y2 = cos(x * 1.3) * 0.25 + 0.5
)

ggplot(df) +
  geom_line(aes(x, y1), linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.7, color = "#39507D") +
  geom_line(aes(x, y2), linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.5, color = "#89A8C5") +
  theme_void() +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.25) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )
```
